# Orgni

> Orgni is an operational layer for businesses. People give it work from wherever they already work (Microsoft Teams, Slack, email, WhatsApp, voice or API); Orgni gathers the business context, works across the company's systems, and returns the finished result. It is built by Olyxee, South Africa.

## What Orgni does

- Takes a request in plain language (for example "@Orgni prepare everything for tomorrow's client meeting") and completes it: reads the relevant documents, contacts the right people, updates systems, and returns the output.
- Works across business systems such as Outlook, Salesforce, Xero, Jira, HubSpot, SAP, GitHub and calendars.
- Keeps business context, memory, identity, permissions and policies in one place, independent of any single interface or AI model (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini).
- Direction: from work that is requested today, to work triggered by business events, to routine work that runs continuously within goals and limits set by the business.

## Use cases

Logistics, finance, sales, operations, customer service and HR. Each use case follows the same pattern: a request, Orgni's activity across files, people and systems, and a delivered result.
